reauth_confirm.description: Your Brunata credentials are no longer valid. Please re-enter them to continue.

reconfigure.description: Change your password, or move to a different email address for the same household. [How this works](https://github.com/MSL-DA/brunata_online/wiki/Changing-your-login)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Brunata API. Check your network connection.

abort.wrong_account: This email belongs to a different account. Log in with the original account.
abort.account_already_configured: That email address is already used by another Brunata integration. Nothing was changed.
abort.meter_mismatch: The account behind that email address does not report all the meters this integration already has, so it is a different household. Nothing was changed.
